items.title: Live: Iran says Trump's ceasefire extension a 'ploy to buy time' as Vance cancels Pakistan trip
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he is extending the ceasefire with Iran. Follow live.

items.title: How Trump went from 'I expect to be bombing' to 'I extend the ceasefire'
items.description: The Iran war ceasefire has been extended but no-one is quite sure on the new deadline, Middle East correspondent Matthew Doran writes.

items.title: Live: Major ASX stock crashes, dragging wider market down
items.description: One of Australia's biggest company's, Cochlear, has rattled investors by slashing its profit outlook. Follow live.

items.title: $50/hour charge for older Australians to shower reversed by government after six months
items.description: The decision to scrap the plan to charge older Australians $50/hour for showers was made after months of sustained criticism, including warnings that people were forgoing other care to afford the service.

items.title: The growing problem stopping Melbourne residents using their microwaves
items.description: A power company warns that growing electricity demand is creating an undervoltage issue as Victoria's infrastructure struggles to keep up with the transition from gas.

items.title: Iran's meme factory is using 'the weapons of their enemy' to embarrass Trump
items.description: AI-generated Lego memes criticising the conflict in the Middle East and mocking Donald Trump are attracting a large audience online as a new front opens in the Iran war.

items.title: Live: Four additional diesel cargoes secured under government's underwriting powers
items.description: Anthony Albanese secures four additional cargoes of diesel for Australia via BP, Viva Energy and Export Finance Australia. Follow live.

items.title: Report finds 'unacceptable' failures after foster kids lived with triple killer
items.description: Some Department of Communities and Justice staff members will face misconduct proceedings after a bungle that saw two foster children living with triple killer Regina Arthurell earlier this year.

items.title: 15yo among five charged over alleged kidnapping of rapper's bodyguard
items.description: Four men and a teenage boy are set to front court today over the alleged assault and kidnapping of a bodyguard for rapper and alleged Alameddine associate Ali Younes.

items.title: 'How many beers have you had?' Flood evacuees claim racial profiling
items.description: Flood evacuees from remote Northern Territory communities say they are being "treated like prisoners" by security guards working at their emergency accommodation centre.

items.title: Closure of specialist centres for children with autism puts spotlight on NDIS funding
items.description: The nationwide closure of specialist centres has put a spotlight on the adequacy of National Disability Insurance Scheme funding for children with "severe, profound, lifelong" autism.

items.title: NRL hit man who suffered 50 concussions says impact of new rules unclear
items.description: Junior rugby league clubs and neuroscientists have welcomed changes to address growing concerns around injuries but say more should be done to protect children.

items.title: Recordings point to second Queensland population of rare night parrot
items.description: Ecologists say thousands of hours of audio recordings have detected night parrot calls in south-west Queensland.

items.title: Aussie junior 'obsessed' with golf set to test his skills overseas
items.description: Alby Weyden was two years old when he became obsessed with golf. Four years on, his family is hoping to raise enough money for him to compete in the Canadian Invitational.

items.title: The artworks we can't stop thinking about from the Adelaide Biennial
items.description: The legacy of nuclear testing, environmental degradation and more among the challenges facing Australia, as explored by artists in the Adelaide Biennial of Australian art.

items.title: 'It's been horrible': Your experiences with family estrangement
items.description: Our recent stories about the grief of family estrangement resonated strongly. Here's how some Australians have been affected by it.

items.title: Travel quiz: Grab your bags and see if you can beat our quiz
items.description: Which city is hosting the first game of the World Cup? What's the name of Egypt's currency?

items.title: In a split second, Keelie made the 'surreal' decision to reveal her abuse
items.description: As Australia marks Sexual Assault Awareness Month, and experts and victim-survivors say sexual violence remains pervasive and under-reported.

items.title: Woman's life 'changed for the better' after GPs in SA trained to diagnose ADHD
items.description: About 100 South Australian GPs are now qualified to diagnose ADHD and provide treatment, with the hope of that number doubling by the end of the year, with one patient describing her diagnosis through her GP as "life-changing".

items.title: SA carer allegedly sexually assaulted woman with disability, police say
items.description: A 55-year-old man from Adelaide's west has been arrested and charged over the alleged sexual assault of a woman with a disability at Glenelg.

items.title: Three weeks' pay guaranteed for Liberty Bell Bay smelter workers
items.description: A short-term rescue package announced by the Tasmanian and federal governments will guarantee the wages of workers at the troubled Liberty Bell Bay smelter.

items.title: Meet the eco-venture turning an invasive pest into dog treats
items.description: Introducing the European carp to Australian waterways is an ecological disaster that continues to worsen, but an Adelaide couple have found a novel use for the pest.

items.title: US authorities probe possible ChatGPT involvement in university shooting
items.description: US authorities are investigating if there was any criminal behaviour involving interactions between Open AI's ChatGPT app and a man accused of killing two people and injuring six others in a shooting at Florida State University.

items.title: Uncounted SA votes in the 'order of dozens', Attorney-General says
items.description: The number of newly revealed uncounted ballot papers from the March state election is believed to be in the "order of dozens", South Australia's Attorney-General says.

items.title: 'Terrifying' experience for WA family as storm tears roof off their home
items.description: A woman describes her "terrifying" ordeal after a powerful cold front which sounded like a "jet plane" tore the roof off her family home while she was inside it on Monday night.
